item.title: UPDATE: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
item.description: At least five people were killed when an Amazon cargo plane barrelled off a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, striking multiple vehicles and bursting into flames. The crash happened at around 2pm local time and sent thick black smoke billowing into the sky, forcing the closure of all runways at one of the country’s busiest airports. Three people were critically injured and two others hospitalised with less severe injuries, Miami-Dade County officials told a news...
